page.notes: Doubtful readings: the Greek word after "ἀωσγέροντας" and "χρίσματα" (the word after "Clemens Alex." is hard to read), the Greek verse lines (ἐδ᾽ ἂν εἰ τὸ φάρμακον, Ἐψεσ᾽ ἔτυχες, Ἐγὼ ὃ ὡς σωλιάς, Καὶ λέγοντοῦ αὐτέ), "συλλυπήσεσιν" and "ἐπιδείξεις" are all uncertain. The start of the page is a fragment ("scere"), so it is marked cont="true". "Iosephus" is normalised from the printed form. Whether "Καὶ λέγοντοῦ" opens a new paragraph is uncertain from the scan. The page ends mid-paragraph.
